scope: Feature readiness assessment only; no row-level feature materialization authorized by this config.

decision_contract.experiment_definition: pdp_2024_sample_context_retrospective: Evaluate 2024 PDP sample-record context fields (native commodity/category/origin/variety/claim codes, sample-unit count and collection-calendar date) as retrospective study inputs for the publicly released 2024 cohort. No chemical-outcome, recall or inspection target is defined or created by this experiment; usda_pdp.results analytical fields remain excluded as label evidence under their existing M4 OUTCOME_EVIDENCE/LABEL classification, independent of this cutoff.
decision_contract.prediction_cutoff_precision: DATE (calendar day; the official posting record states a date only, no time-of-day)

availability_evidence.source: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service, official dataset page 'PDP Databases and Annual Summaries'
availability_evidence.interpretation: PDP24Samples.txt and PDP24Results.txt are both members of the single pinned 2024PDPDatabase.zip archive (see configs/source_contracts.json usda_pdp.samples/results source.artifacts). AMS records exactly one public posting date for that whole archive, 2025-12-23, with no earlier publication evidence for either member. This establishes a verified upper bound: every usda_pdp.samples field became publicly available no earlier than 2025-12-23, which is at/before the documented prediction_cutoff. It does not show sample-context fields were available earlier than analytical result fields, so it cannot and does not justify treating any usda_pdp.results field as a predictor.

pdp_2024_archive_posting.source: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service, official dataset page 'PDP Databases and Annual Summaries'

m5_verified_tables.reason: Every usda_pdp.samples field ships inside the single archive posted on this date; no earlier public posting is evidenced.

m5_verified_inputs.predictor_justification: Native commodity code; M4 role=CONTEXT, not OUTCOME_EVIDENCE/RETROSPECTIVE_CONTEXT/IDENTIFIER/LINEAGE.
Import-origin country code; M4 role=CONTEXT; null remains null, not imputed.
Publisher free-text variety description; M4 role=CONTEXT.
Label claim code, not a laboratory finding; M4 role=CONTEXT.
Sample unit count; M4 role=CONTEXT; unit already VERIFIED (count_individual_sample_units).
Validated collection calendar date; M4 role=REFERENCE_TIME, used only to derive deterministic calendar-context features, not assay timing.

unmet_requirement_definitions.MISSINGNESS_SEMANTICS_POLICY_UNDEFINED: Decide unknown/not-applicable/not-measured separately using pre-cutoff evidence; do not encode analytical ND/NP censoring as a predictor.
unmet_requirement_definitions.BATCH_SENSOR_SERIES_ABSENT: No acquired eligible table has a genuine batch-linked storage/transport temperature/humidity series with sensor timestamps.
unmet_requirement_definitions.PRODUCT_STAGE_TEMPERATURE_POLICY_ABSENT: No approved product/category/stage thresholds or their effective dates; no universal safe temperature may be substituted.
unmet_requirement_definitions.SENSOR_QA_GAP_POLICY_UNDEFINED: Sensor validation, interpolation, coverage and maximum-gap rules are not defined.
unmet_requirement_definitions.SUPPLY_CHAIN_ENDPOINTS_ABSENT: Harvest/processing/dispatch/arrival timestamps and verified batch/shipment identities are absent from the observed tables.
unmet_requirement_definitions.EXPIRY_SHELF_METADATA_ABSENT: No verified expiry date, retail arrival or shelf-life record is present.
unmet_requirement_definitions.VERIFIED_SUPPLIER_FACILITY_ID_ABSENT: M4 explicitly has no supplier/farm/factory crosswalk; PDP SOURCE_ID is a suffix and LAB is an analytical laboratory.
unmet_requirement_definitions.TEST_RESULT_AVAILABILITY_ABSENT: Collection dates do not establish when each test result was available; FSIS samples are also not acquired.
unmet_requirement_definitions.COMPARABLE_TEST_POLICY_UNDEFINED: No approved source/analyte/program/re-extraction comparability and tested denominator policy for history.
unmet_requirement_definitions.FOCAL_SAMPLE_EXCLUSION_POLICY_UNDEFINED: History must exclude the focal sample and related duplicate/re-extraction records using explicit identity and timing rules.
unmet_requirement_definitions.VERIFIED_RECALL_ENTITY_LINKAGE_ABSENT: Recalling-firm text is not a verified supplier/facility entity; no name-based cross-source matching allowed.
unmet_requirement_definitions.HISTORICAL_RECALL_FIELD_VERSIONS_ABSENT: Current snapshot dates and classification/status do not prove historical field versions; original download provenance remains incomplete.
unmet_requirement_definitions.HISTORY_WINDOW_POLICY_UNDEFINED: History event grain, strict event+availability cutoffs and window boundaries remain undefined.
unmet_requirement_definitions.INSPECTION_FAILURE_POLICY_UNDEFINED: No approved NAI/VAI/OAI failure interpretation, project-area deduplication and public-availability policy.
unmet_requirement_definitions.WEATHER_WINDOW_POLICY_UNDEFINED: No approved station-window endpoint, period, completed-day rules or heat/rain threshold policy.
unmet_requirement_definitions.WEATHER_DAY_BOUNDARIES_UNVERIFIED: Daily reporting date is not a proven prediction-time measurement interval/timezone or first-publication time.
unmet_requirement_definitions.WEATHER_QA_COVERAGE_POLICY_UNDEFINED: No approved treatment for QFLAG, MFLAG, source semantics, absent dates or -9999 gaps; missing must not become zero.
unmet_requirement_definitions.AGRICULTURAL_RELEASE_AVAILABILITY_ABSENT: Annual reference years (district 2017; state 2014–2024) are not release dates; no as-of publication/version evidence.
unmet_requirement_definitions.GEOGRAPHICAL_LEVEL_POLICY_UNDEFINED: National/state totals overlap; district keys/conflicts and future geographical applicability require explicit policy.
